subject: rows were removed since the rsIDs for these SNPs were not present in the reference file

messages.author: e12f24d1855774ef
messages.subject: rows were removed since the rsIDs for these SNPs were not present in the reference file
parts:
Good morning,

I am running GenomicSEM for a rat population. I created a reference file using the same head as the one present on the reference file used on the tutorial "w_hm3.snplist". When running the sumstats function I got this error:

[1] "3513491 rows present in the full /projects/ps-palmer/joel/ldsc/mungeSEM4/ccc/d1Vel.sumstats.gz summary statistics file."
[1] "3513491 rows were removed from the /projects/ps-palmer/joel/ldsc/mungeSEM4/ccc/d1Vel.sumstats.gz summary statistics file as the rsIDs for these SNPs were not present in the reference file."

however, I was able to run the munge function which uses the same reference file. Is it because the snps are not labeled including a rsID? I am using the genomic location for this matter.

Best,
Joel

messages.author: 3b39745f73eec779
messages.subject: Re: rows were removed since the rsIDs for these SNPs were not present in the reference file
parts:
Super interesting to hear you are using GenomicSEM on non humans!

If you make your own LDSC and ref files with a SNP Column and this column is the same across files then this will work out fine. Our human bias made us word the warning that way.

By the way later In the LDSC step you should adjust the “chr=“ argument which defaults to 22.

Best,
Michel
